name: keyframer-inspector
description: Give your coding agent eyes for motion. The Keyframer Inspector MCP server lets it record a running iOS, Android, React Native or Flutter app, slow it down to 0.1x and step frames, read the motion problems ranked by frames lost with a fix for your framework, compare before and after, and hold animations in CI with check files. Includes the setup, motion-debugging, fix, CI and Motion Vitals skills.
